title: Domain and Range Swap
text: KEY INSIGHT: The domain of $f^{-1}$ equals the range of $f$, and the range of $f^{-1}$ equals the domain of $f$.

title: Find the Range of f(x)
text:
For $f(x) = x^2 - 4$ with $x \geq 0$:

The minimum value occurs at $x = 0$: $f(0) = 0^2 - 4 = -4$

As $x$ increases, $f(x)$ increases without bound.
